instruction: A candid documentary full shot of an indoor motion capture studio featuring a red carpeted floor and white walls. On the left, the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) balances on her left leg, delivering a high side kick with her right leg. On the right, the man in the black shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands facing left, receiving the kick near his chest while raising his hands. Bright overhead fluorescent lighting illuminates the entire scene, casting soft shadows on the red carpet.
